description: A contract whose only job is to put the forms the manifest format grew later on a real connection: a map, a newtype, and a field that is both absent-able and defaulted.

The token tests in peerline-contract-macros can read what the expansion says — that the attribute is there, that the struct is a tuple struct, that the predicate compares against the getter. What they cannot do is put the bytes on a wire and decode them at the other end, and every one of these three forms makes a claim about bytes: a map is a JSON object, a newtype is wire-identical to what it wraps, and a defaulted absent-able key is genuinely missing from the object rather than written as its value.

types.name: HostId
description: Which host, in this contract's own namespace.
A string on the wire and nothing else, which is the claim the round trip below checks against a literal rather than against the other end.

types.name: Millis
description: A duration in milliseconds. A newtype over a number, so that transparency is checked for something that is not a string.

types.name: Report
description: Every field is one of the cases under test, and the fields that are not absent-able are here so that a decode failure has something to be a failure about.

fields.name: host
description: Where it ran. A required newtype, so the key is always written and its value is the bare string.

fields.name: env
description: The environment it ran with, keyed by variable name. A required map, so the key is always written and its value is a JSON object.

fields.name: counts
description: Per-name counters. Absent means none, and a writer omits the key rather than writing an empty object.

fields.name: tags
description: Whatever it tagged itself with. Absent means none.

fields.name: label
description: What to call it in a listing. Absent means it was not named.

fields.name: took
description: How long it ran. Absent means no time at all — the pair through a newtype, so the comparison runs against a wrapped value.

fields.name: note
description: Anything else it said. Absent-able with no default, which is the state this one is here to be distinguished from: absence means nothing was said, and there is no value to apply.

errors.name: no_such_host
description: The host named is not one this producer knows. Inside the band this contract claims, which is the whole of what claiming one asserts.

ops.name: demo.forms.round
description: Take a report and hand back exactly what arrived, so that a difference between the two ends is a difference in the value.

ops.name: demo.forms.host
description: The host the report named, as a bare newtype result — the position where transparency is most visible, because there is no surrounding object to hide an envelope in.

ops.name: demo.forms.env.read
description: The report's environment, as a map result. A map is a value like any other and travels in a result position as readily as in a field.

ops.name: demo.forms.watch
description: The report that arrived, emitted as stream items. A stream item is put on the wire by a different encoder than a unary result, so a form that was right for one and wrong for the other would pass every unary test.
